description: Header file defining the AmbiorixImpl class and related types for managing Ambiorix instances, including methods for data model loading, parameter setting and reading, instance management, and event handling within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: AmbiorixImpl
classes.description: Manages Ambiorix instances, handles data model loading, parameter operations, instance management, and event handling.

methods.name: AmbiorixImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with event loop, action handlers, events, and functions.

methods.name: ~AmbiorixImpl
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources such as bus connection, data model, and event handlers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Ambiorix library, loads backends, connects to bus, loads data model, and registers it.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value for a given relative path, overloaded for various data types.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Reads a parameter value from a specified object path, overloaded for various data types.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance at the specified relative path.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Removes an instance at the specified index from the given relative path.

methods.name: get_instance_index
methods.description: Retrieves the index of an instance based on specific path and key.

methods.name: get_datamodel_time_format
methods.description: Returns the data model's time format string.

methods.name: set_current_time
methods.description: Sets current time in RFC 3339 format for a specified object.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Sets the 'TimeStamp' field in RFC 3339 format.

methods.name: remove_all_instances
methods.description: Removes all instances under a specified relative path.

methods.name: add_optional_subobject
methods.description: Adds an optional subobject to a specified object.

methods.name: remove_optional_subobject
methods.description: Removes an optional subobject from a specified object.

methods.name: load_datamodel
methods.description: Loads and parses the data model from an ODL file.
